premises.text: 2.7 billion people are deskless workers who need better employment solutions
premises.evidence_span: 2.7 billion people didn't. That is 80% of the entire global workforce.

premises.text: Current employment solutions do not meet the needs of deskless workers
premises.evidence_span: Current employment solutions are not actually built for these workers.

premises.text: Deskless workers face issues with safety, payment, and support
premises.evidence_span: More than 50% of these deskless workers are having issues with the current system.

premises.text: Employers lack the structure to meet the needs of deskless workers
premises.evidence_span: employers have no structure or no setup to meet the needs of these deskless workers.

premises.text: Antil provides a two-way support portal for deskless workers
premises.evidence_span: Introducing Antil, a two-way support portal for the deskless workers.

premises.text: Text messaging is the most accessible technology for deskless workers
premises.evidence_span: Antil delivers through the most accessible technology out there, text messaging.

premises.text: Antil enables automatic replies to FAQs and translates into over 110 languages
premises.evidence_span: Our system enables access to the software, replies to FAQs automatically, translates into over 110 languages.

premises.text: High turnover rates among deskless workers are costly for employers
premises.evidence_span: On average, companies are facing above 47% of turnover rates, which cost them more than $20,000 per person to rehire and train them in a timely manner.

premises.text: Antil provides employers with visibility into their deskless workforce
premises.evidence_span: Antil provides employers with the tools to engage with their deskless workers and the transparency to see what every side is doing.

premises.text: Antil improves retention by enhancing communication between employees and employers
premises.evidence_span: Antil is reconciling employees and employers by creating a bridge between them.

value.text: Antil helps both employees and employers by improving communication and reducing turnover
value.evidence_span: Antil connects everyone. Antil helps both employees and employers.

notes: Traction metrics and specific customer counts are excluded as they do not support premises.
